title: coelocline acutiflora
intro: Coelocline acutiflora, commonly known as the False Verbena, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It is used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Coelocline acutiflora include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
